text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I shan't allow you to say 'twas not my
back what
plowed this field!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I fell asleep. Can we pretend that
didn't
happen?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I got a little too caught up in my favorite period drama on my day off.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now, whenever I close my eyes, I just see this fight scene they had in the white sand outside the estate... Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like Wonder Acute didn't get
much rest.
